patch_description: Replace the fixed exponentially weighted average with a causal robust alpha-beta tracker. Unlike a window average, this predictor explicitly estimates both level and slope, so its one-sample prediction compensates filtering lag. Innovation magnitude is measured against a rolling MAD noise estimate; large isolated deviations are clipped rather than allowed to create spurious direction changes. Gains increase only for persistent, statistically significant innovations, preserving responsiveness during genuine moves while retaining strong smoothing in noisy periods. A slope deadband suppresses low-amplitude sign flips that are likely noise-induced reversals. The returned samples remain aligned to the trailing endpoint of each window, preserving the current public output-length and alignment contract.
